title_as_printed: A dynamic time series inference learning framework for individualized prediction of mild cognitive impairment progression

blind_codes.Sample_N: 1667 analysed = 1393 ADNI-1/2/GO pre-training cohort (897-subject longitudinal training subset) + 101 internal held-out test (Dataset B) + 173 external test (Dataset A: 29 ADNI-3 + 144 OASIS-3); Table 1 lists 1566; ADNI-1/2/GO source pool 2430

Task_Type.reason: Explicit sMCI vs pMCI (MCI-to-AD within 36 months) conversion prediction, reported as AUC and accuracy.
Task_Type.quote: subjects diagnosed with MCI at all time points are defined as sMCI; subjects diagnosed with MCI at any follow-up visit and who progressed to AD within three years are defined as pMCI

Category.reason: Structural MRI is the only input modality; CDRSB serves only as a supervision label.

Validation_Type.reason: The paper has a separate held-out test partition (8:2 split of ADNI-1/2/GO, Dataset B) and an external test set (Dataset A) that includes 144 OASIS-3 subjects from a different cohort/institution; the headline comparisons (Tables 3 and 6) are on Dataset A. V2 (k-fold on the same data, no separate test set) is contradicted. ADNI-3 alone would not count as external under the definitions, but OASIS-3 does; even on the strictest reading the floor is V3 (held-out test partition), not V2.
Validation_Type.quote: Dataset A, as an independent external test set, consists of baseline T1-weighted sMRI images from 29 subjects in ADNI-3 and 144 subjects in OASIS-3.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The paper reports several Ns: 1393 pre-training subjects (Table 1), an 897-subject training subset, 101 internal test subjects (Dataset B) and 173 external test subjects (Dataset A). The registry's 1393 is the discovery/training-cohort N and omits the 274 test subjects on which performance is reported.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: 551 subjects lacking Clinical Dementia Rating Sum of Boxes (CDRSB) were excluded, and 1393 subjects with complete CDRSB data were included, totaling 6313 sMRI images

Publication_Year.reason: Online 25 November 2025; issue is volume 302 (2026). Either year is acceptable.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: ADNI-1/2/GO is the sole training source (and ADNI-3 supplies test subjects); OASIS-3 is only a secondary external test set.
ADNI_Dependent.quote: the 2430 subjects from ADNI-1/2/GO were divided into the overall training set and the overall testing set in an 8:2 ratio

notes: The Validation_Type error bears directly on the review's external-validation statistic. This classification study trains on ADNI-1/2/GO and tests on an independent OASIS-3 cohort (plus ADNI-3 and an 8:2 internal held-out split), so it belongs with the V4 studies, not V2. The registry N (1393) is the training cohort only; performance figures come from the 101 + 173 test subjects.
